## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek man who lives quietly and unobtrusively. He lacks any will power to exert for himself.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Thomas Lynde was historically ruled by his mother until his marriage, after which his wife [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) took over directing his willpower. At the time of his wedding, he planted June lilies. His eventual death led [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to propose that [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), allowing [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), [v3 ch.Home P14](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0014)_

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde was the husband of [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) until his death. His passing leads [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to propose that the newly widowed [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) can attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
